content: FastAPI large-app structure consensus (zhanymkanov/fastapi-best-practices and others): app/ split into routers (HTTP surface), services (business workflows), repositories (DB access), schemas (pydantic), core (config/infra), dependencies. Two competing organizations: layer-first (routers/services/repos) vs feature-first modules each holding router.py/service.py/schemas.py/dependencies.py. Router-level dependencies (APIRouter(dependencies=[...])) are the DRY mechanism for cross-cutting auth; layer dependencies so auth is at router level and role checks at endpoint level. Use exception_handler decorators for uniform error mapping; env-based settings via pydantic-settings.
